parts.text: Study how physics-aware adaptation of a pretrained generator improves human motion synthesis and contact with objects. Evaluate physical plausibility and interaction quality against baseline methods.

Six-month M2 internship, from February 2027. Selection begins on 1 December 2026. The call gives 31 December as a flexible deadline and reviews candidates as they apply. Send the requested documents to the recruitment contact under the subject Internship-UPA-TSP.
